title: Landing, sign-in, sign-out, and first-run onboarding surfaces
asA: visitor arriving for the first time or returning to sign in
iWant: arrival and authentication screens that are designed, fast, and self-explanatory
soThat: my first minutes with the product feel intentional

acceptanceCriteria.description: The unauthenticated landing surface renders per its wireframe: product identity, a statement of value, and the sign-in entry point, at every baseline breakpoint in both themes.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the landing renders at each breakpoint
acceptanceCriteria.then: the designed surface renders with no auth-gated blank regions

acceptanceCriteria.description: The sign-in surface follows the sign-in wireframe and the application-spa-REQ-007 form contract, including a designed failure state that names the problem without revealing which credential element was wrong.
acceptanceCriteria.when: valid and invalid submissions are made
acceptanceCriteria.then: success routes onward and failure renders safe, actionable copy

acceptanceCriteria.description: Sign-in shows a pending state during verification and prevents duplicate submission.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the submit control is busy per application-spa-US-1108 and repeat submits are ignored

acceptanceCriteria.description: Sign-out is available from the shell on every authenticated route, completes to the designed signed-out confirmation surface, and clears client caches per ADR-205.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a signed-in user on any route
acceptanceCriteria.then: the confirmation surface renders and cached user data is gone

acceptanceCriteria.description: First-run onboarding renders for a first-signed-in user per its specification, is skippable, and never renders again once completed or skipped.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a first sign-in and a later sign-in
acceptanceCriteria.then: onboarding shows once, is skippable, and does not recur

acceptanceCriteria.description: All arrival and auth surfaces meet application-spa-REQ-019 and application-spa-REQ-004 on the same terms as authenticated routes.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the same bars pass; these surfaces are not exempt
